calls.title: New pitch deck rollout
calls.summary:
# New pitch deck rollout
Date: 2026-10-07 | Duration: 41m

## Summary
The team finalized a concise sales deck centered on unified messaging, the ABAP differentiation acronym, AI-driven experimentation, and Growth Book’s developer-first, open-source, warehouse-native positioning. The deck is designed for five-minute presentations and encourages sales teams to practice, gather feedback, and focus on generating demo interest. AI messaging should introduce Growth Book’s capabilities without overwhelming prospects, emphasizing flexible, non-opinionated integration with existing workflows and reserving deeper details for live demonstrations. The team also proposed a “What We Heard” slide to capture customer priorities and evolve across calls. Scott Bailey demonstrated an AI-powered deck-building skill connected to Claude AI and Google Slides that uses sources such as Notion, HubSpot, and Fireflies, while preserving core messaging and enabling regional, client-specific, and optional content. James Shannon said it produces about 80% of the deck accurately, though some manual editing remains. The team discussed adoption challenges, feedback loops, and plans to share materials broadly.

## Keywords
pitch deck, sales enablement, AI skills, customization, feature flagging, customer engagement

## Action Items

**Ashley Stirrup**
Encourage the sales team to practice delivering the new pitch deck and provide feedback to enable iterative improvements in messaging and content (11:19)
Collaborate to develop a more interactive, discovery-focused pitch deck format that includes embedded questions to engage customers and gather their input during presentations (16:30)

**Scott Bailey**
Share the finalized demo pitch deck link with the sales team to ensure access to the latest materials (29:08)
Continue iterating and improving the AI-powered deck-building skill based on user feedback to reduce errors, improve accuracy, and minimize the need for manual edits (25:35)
Assist the sales team in adopting the AI deck-building skill, providing support for customization options and establishing guardrails to prevent issues like excessive text or inappropriate quotes (16:47)

**Elyse Fox**
Share all presentation materials, including updated pitch decks and AI skill resources, in the sales channel to ensure team-wide access and facilitate ongoing feedback (30:51)

**James Shannon**
Provide further detailed feedback on the AI pitch deck skill, specifically regarding text length and inclusion of direct customer quotes, to help refine guardrails and improve output quality (24:40)
